messages.subject: error message with melted data.frame
parts:
Hi,

I've collected P-values in a list, which looks like:
list(parameter1 = -log10(0.1), parameter2 = -log(0.001), etc.)
And then I would like to create a bar plot where each par represents the by -log10 transformed P-value. My attempt so far:

> require(reshape2)
> pvalues <- list(parameter1 = -log(0.1), parameter2 = -log(0.001))
> pvalues <- melt(pvalues)
> ggplot(pvalues, aes(x = L1, y = value)) + geom_bar() + coord_flip()

While this minimal example is working, my actual code gives

Error in unit(at, "native") : 'x' and 'units' must have length > 0

when calling ggsave with only the filename as argument.

Any hints what might be going wrong?

TIA
Christian

My mistake: I was calling qplot instead of ggplot in the script -- which is pretty stupid.
